body.name: Non-oracle coherent nuisance-rate handle
body.construction: Use \(\mathfrak F\) as follows.  On \(\mathcal M^{\beta}_{K,\varepsilon}(B_{\mathrm H})\), fit one tensor-product B-spline product likelihood for \((\pi,M_A,M_Z,f)\) with \(s_n\asymp n^{(d_X+1)/(2\beta+d_X+1)}\), allowing unrestricted measurement supports unless support sets are supplied as observed design information.  Choose from the \(K!\) common permutations the maximizer of the empirical training-sample minimum diagonal-minus-largest-off-diagonal self-report probability.  Enforce only the fitted half-margin inequalities in the coherent-fit definition, choose \(\tau_{S,n}\) without true-support information, set \(\tau_G=\varepsilon/2\), and derive \(w,W,B,d,D,R,N,h,G,b_{(\cdot)},b_U\), \(\widehat G_{\tau_G}^{\dagger}\), \(Q\), and the leakage allowances by the displayed plug-in identities.  The output contains one fitted product law and does not take a true support, the true \(G\), or a true rank as an input.
